name: nested_plus_overlap
rationale: Two unbounded branches accept the same nonempty pump while the successful assertion sees the failing suffix.

name: class_prefix_overlap
rationale: A broad character-class branch overlaps a constrained-prefix branch.

name: optional_suffix_overlap
rationale: An optional branch suffix creates overlap without relying on a character class.

name: fixed_word_overlap
rationale: Distinct ordinary syntax accepts a shared fixed pump word, isolating repeated branch choice from assertion cost.

name: bounded_repeat_overlap
rationale: Overlapping bounded quantifiers test the real frontend's counted-repeat translation.
